install_steps: Run the interactive setup script: cd ~/ai/supercli/plugins/gopass && ./setup.sh
The setup script handles GPG key generation, gopass initialization, and environment configuration
Restart your shell or source your config: source ~/.zshrc or source ~/.bashrc
note: The interactive setup script (./setup.sh) provides secure master password configuration - the AI never sees your password. For automation, use gopass with '--yes' flag to skip confirmations. Store is at ~/.local/share/gopass by default. Supports age encryption as alternative to GPG.
